patch_description: This crossover retains the independently trainable RY–RZ local layers from the current program while adopting the empirically stronger open CZ chain from the best-performing inspiration program. Removing the closing CZ edge between wires 7 and 0 avoids an unnecessary serialization bottleneck: the parameter count remains 146, while the measured depth drops from 120 to 99 and the gate count from 276 to 270. The supplied metrics indicate that this topology also improves validation accuracy from 0.87 to 0.89, reduces the generalization gap from 0.10 to 0.07, lowers validation loss, and reaches the convergence threshold. All fixed feature mapping, re-uploading, training, measurement, and output behavior remain unchanged.
